resources.string: Counted once the day has finished.
No readings for this figure yet. Your band delivers them after a sync.
Totals are for the calendar day in your time zone, as your band reports them. Apex shows them as delivered and never estimates a missing day.
Active minutes are split by how hard the movement was. Sedentary time is only known once the day has finished.
On the chart, a gap means no reading that day. Select a day, then open it to see its totals.
